name: florian, voldaren scion
mana cost: {1}{B}{R}
types: legendary creature vampire noble
power toughness: 3/3
static: first strike
triggered: at the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the total amount of life your opponents lost this turn. exile one of those cards and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. you may play the exiled card this turn.
